help: usage: fleet-switchboard review [-h] {laws,blockers,record,measure} ... positional arguments: {laws,blockers,record,measure} laws Print the repository's review laws and overlay as they stand at the PR's BASE commit blockers Read-only: the reviewers whose LATEST recorded result at the PR's head is request-changes (one line each) record Record a reviewer's result for the PR's current head (the coder session records what the reviewer returned) measure Read-only: per merged PR, time to green CI, review rounds, findings, escaped defects; baseline and after medians options: -h, --help show this help message and exit
